fixed_parameters.scope: All 21 detailed statistics, fixed personal-risk ledger comparisons, fresh six-config Crypto entry screen and one Crypto prototype
fixed_parameters.existing_ledger: Reuse 1159 saved trades without regenerating; do not call risk rescaling a fresh entry test
fixed_parameters.symbols: Existing ten launch symbols, existing DOGE 5m / LTC 15m / ETH 1h scopes
fixed_parameters.new_prototype: BTC/ETH/SOL 15m compression-breakout sprint: previous five-bar mean range <= .8 ATR, close beyond previous 20-bar range, body fraction >= .6, 2 ATR stop / 2R target / 12-bar hold; last known funding absolute rate <= .001
fixed_parameters.risk_only_control: Personal research only: fixed daily 15%, peak 60%, aggregate risk 15%, correlated Crypto risk 10%, entry margin 50%; no live/default/account updates
fixed_parameters.execution: OHLC next-bar entry, conservative stop-first ambiguity, explicit fees/slippage, actual funding where available, current minimum-lot/notional specs, approximate isolated liquidation guard
fixed_parameters.caveats: No tick-level or provider qualification claim; no guaranteed returns. No Prop change; no martingale/grid/recovery escalation. Keep prototype outside customer catalogue pending evidence.

limitations: OHLC screen, not historical bid/ask/mark-price/order-book execution. Intrabar STOP_FIRST and conservative TP1/BE policy are assumptions.
Drawdown is close-sampled account equity, not a verified intrabar maximum. Daily/peak guards act at sampled observations and can overshoot.
Current retrieved lot/notional filters and fixed .5% maintenance scenario are not verified historical margin tiers. Liquidation-before-stop rejection is approximate.
Observed funding uses recorded marks when supplied. Funding/fees reduce equity; no assumption that leverage multiplies returns on unchanged positions.
Combination admission ranks reward/risk with deterministic ties under shared limits; this research router is not production Smart Account Brain parity.
One November-to-date period cannot establish median monthly returns, profitable-month percentage, future account survival or venue qualification.
Source data includes warmup outside November; signals/positions are restricted to November 1–27 exclusive.
Original full decision risk remains reserved until final closure, including after partial exits; this is a conservative reservation model.
Terminal positions are costed at the cutoff; the terminal audit separates their decision cash from natural closures.
All scenarios are Personal research, no defaults/Prop/live activation; aggressive cases allow severe drawdowns.
Full $100 monthly subscription is an external cost sensitivity, not withdrawn from trading collateral.
The ETH complementary rule is newly screened on perpetual candles, unlike the earlier spot-reference ledger.
